name: Arthur Bartenstein
bio: Arthur's career has focused on the adaptation of historic and/or environmentally sensitive landscapes to contemporary needs and goals. His wide-ranging experience includes master planning and landscape architecture for university and corporate campuses, retirement communities, urban streetscapes, churches, private estates, regional parks, historic battlefields and public museum grounds.

Arthur's work has received numerous honors including four national and three state American Society of Landscape Architecture awards. Prior to founding ABL Landscape Architecture, Arthur practiced with Peter Walker and Partners and the SWA Group (based in California) as well as Hill Studio and Frazier Associates (based in Virginia).

facts.label: Education
items: Master of Landscape Architecture, Harvard University Graduate School of Design, 1981
Bachelor of Arts, Hampshire College, Amherst, MA, 1976

facts.label: Registration
items: Registered Landscape Architect, Commonwealth of Virginia

facts.label: Professional and civic affiliations

Friends of Natural Bridge State Park

name: Kelly K. Morikawa
bio: Kelly converted to full-time horticultural consultant following 18 years' experience owning and operating a multi-crew landscape design, installation, and maintenance company in the Lexington / Rockbridge area. She combines passion for both plants and natural resource conservation with down-to-earth, real world experience.

facts.label: Education
items: Horticultural and business courses and workshops at Blue Ridge Community College, Virginia Western Community College, Mid-Atlantic Horticulture Short Course, Trees Virginia and Lewis Ginter Botanical Garden

facts.label: Certification
items: Certified Arborist, International Society of Arboriculture, since 2006
Virginia Certified Horticulturist, Virginia Nursery & Landscape Association, since 2002
